HazardDescription: PLACEHOLDER: Hot work performed without an authorized permit program per NFPA 51B guidance increases the risk of uncontrolled ignition of nearby combustibles from welding, cutting, or brazing sparks.
RecommendedControls: PLACEHOLDER: Require a written hot work permit, issued by an authorized individual, before any cutting, welding, or brazing operation begins.
PPERecommendations: PLACEHOLDER: Welding helmet, flame-resistant clothing, and welding gloves required for all hot work permit holders.
HotWorkGuidance: PLACEHOLDER: Follow NFPA 51B hot work permit guidance before beginning any cutting, welding, or brazing operation.

Controls.ControlDescription: PLACEHOLDER: Hot work permit required before work begins, valid for the shift only.
Controls.Rationale: Permit-controlled work gates ignition-source activity behind an authorization step.

Controls.ControlDescription: PLACEHOLDER: Hot work permit issuer and operator training on NFPA 51B guidance.
Controls.Rationale: Awareness control supporting correct permit issuance and hazard recognition.

Controls.ControlDescription: PLACEHOLDER: Flame-resistant clothing and welding PPE required for the duration of hot work.
Controls.Rationale: Direct personal protection against sparks, spatter, and radiant heat.

HazardName: Fire Watch During and After Hot Work
HazardDescription: PLACEHOLDER: Hot work conducted without a dedicated fire watch per NFPA 51B guidance risks an undetected smoldering ignition developing into a fire protection incident after the work crew has left the area.
RecommendedControls: PLACEHOLDER: Assign a trained fire watch for the duration of hot work and for at least 30 minutes after completion, with a fire extinguisher immediately available.
PPERecommendations: PLACEHOLDER: Fire watch personnel equipped with a portable fire extinguisher and means to sound an alarm.
HotWorkGuidance: PLACEHOLDER: Follow NFPA 51B fire watch guidance for hot work operations conducted outside a designated hot work area.

Controls.ControlDescription: PLACEHOLDER: Fire watch performs periodic area checks for smoldering material during and after hot work.
Controls.Rationale: Direct fire-protection detection control during the highest-risk window after ignition sources are active.

Controls.ControlDescription: PLACEHOLDER: Fire watch personnel trained on extinguisher use and evacuation notification per NFPA 51B guidance.
Controls.Rationale: Awareness control ensuring the fire watch can respond effectively.

Controls.ControlDescription: PLACEHOLDER: Fire watch assignment recorded on the hot work permit.
Controls.Rationale: Permit-controlled work; fire watch assignment is a condition of permit issuance.

HazardName: Removal of Flammable and Combustible Materials from the Hot Work Area
HazardDescription: PLACEHOLDER: Flammable liquids, combustible dust, and other combustible materials left within the hot work area per NFPA 51B guidance can ignite from sparks or slag, creating both a fire protection incident and an environmental release risk if flammable materials are involved.
RecommendedControls: PLACEHOLDER: Relocate or shield flammable and combustible materials at least 35 feet from the hot work operation, or protect them with fire-resistant covers.
PPERecommendations: PLACEHOLDER: Standard flame-resistant clothing plus spill-control PPE when flammable liquid containers are relocated.
HotWorkGuidance: PLACEHOLDER: Follow NFPA 51B combustible-material clearance guidance before hot work begins.
FlammableMaterialsGuidance: PLACEHOLDER: Flammable liquids and combustible dust within the hot work radius require removal, shielding, or vapor control per NFPA 51B guidance before work is authorized.

Controls.ControlDescription: PLACEHOLDER: Pre-work area inspection confirming a 35-foot combustible-free radius.
Controls.Rationale: Verification control performed before ignition sources become active.

Controls.ControlDescription: PLACEHOLDER: Area clearance sign-off required as a precondition of hot work permit issuance.
Controls.Rationale: Permit-controlled work; clearance verification gates authorization.

Controls.ControlDescription: PLACEHOLDER: Spill-control PPE for personnel relocating flammable liquid containers.
Controls.Rationale: Direct protection during handling of flammable materials.
